prompt:
Use the attached ORIGINAL ASHVEIL ash crow only for the same bird identity, charcoal layered feather material, restrained blue-grey edge highlights, pointed sturdy black beak, small dark eyes, short wedge tail, two feathered wings and two scaly taloned legs. Create new original detailed crisp pixel-art motion poses. No human arms, extra wings, extra legs, bat membranes, gear, messenger tube, red string, magic, glowing parts, blood/gore, impact effects or props.

FORMAT: exactly FOUR ROWS by FOUR COLUMNS, sixteen separate whole birds on true transparent RGBA. Row1 FRONT toward bottom/viewer; row2 LEFT beak left/tail right; row3 RIGHT beak right/tail left; row4 BACK facing away to top, beak hidden/tail nearest viewer. Each row keeps its own direction through all four columns. Consistent elevated three-quarter game camera and head/body scale. Very generous transparent gutters: each entire silhouette occupies only the central HALF of its cell, all feathers/beak/toes safely inside, never overlap any neighboring rectangular crop. No scenery/floor/shadow/grid/labels/text/checkerboard/background colors. Same grounded projection within a row, no resizing a bird to fill a different pose.

MOTION: original WAKING/GETTING UP, four independently drawn consecutive poses, not a pasted/reversed falling animation: column1 low sleeping crouch with head tucked under wing and both wings folded; column2 head and beak emerge, eyes open, chest rises while both feet extend underneath to brace; column3 legs extend to lift body upright, BOTH wings stretch a small matching amount for balance, tail settles; column4 awake standing on exactly two feet with wings neatly folded and head alert. Full coordinated two-legged bird anatomy, no hovering flight, no detached wings, no extra feet. Keep each row's direction; rear row head emerges away from viewer and face remains hidden. Body/head size consistent during the rise, merely posture and wing/leg articulation change.
